why: Git for Windows on this machine is at D:\Program Files\Git, not a location Archon autodetects. A one-node workflow (bash: echo hello from $(uname -s)) was run with --no-worktree twice: without and with ARCHON_BASH_PATH.
workflow:
name: bash-probe
description: one bash node
nodes:
  - id: hello
    bash: echo hello from $(uname -s)
without:
[hello] Started
[hello] Failed: Bash node 'hello' failed: bash executable not found at 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe'. Set ARCHON_BASH_PATH if Git Bash is installed elsewhere (e.g. user-scope installer at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Git\bin\bash.exe).
Error: Workflow failed: Workflow did not complete successfully
